name: io.github.igiamronit/justbetter-mcp
title: JustBetter MCP
description: An MCP gateway with dynamic, retrieval-based tool injection. Exposes two tools instead of hundreds, and retrieves the rest on demand.

packageArguments.description: Runs the Mode 2 stdio gateway. Without it the package starts its interactive TUI, which is not what an MCP client wants.

environmentVariables.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Only needed for Mode 1 semantic prompt injection. Mode 2 tool discovery works without any provider key.

environmentVariables.name: MISTRAL_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Alternative provider for Mode 1. Mode 2 tool discovery works without any provider key.

environmentVariables.name: JUSTBETTER_HOME
environmentVariables.description: Overrides where config, the tool catalog and the embedding model are stored. Defaults to ~/.justbetter-mcp.
